blocks.text: AN OPEN COLLECTION THESE RECORDS CAME FROM
The Met publishes its whole collection catalogue as open data, and marks which objects are free of copyright. It is the largest single source here by a wide margin.
35,920 records are held for this collection and 120 are listed here — the ones its own records tie to something biblical, audited first. The rest are in the research corpus, not on this page.
